He is associated with work such as Vicky Donor, Dum Laga Ke Haisha and Andhadhun and has been recognised with Filmfare Awards and Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut.

sections.heading: Ayushmann Khurrana — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Ayushmann Khurrana was born on 14 September 1984 in Chandigarh, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, P. Khurrana and his mother, Poonam Khurrana. He is a sibling of Aparshakti Khurana.
His listed education includes St. John's High School, Chandigarh and DAV College, Chandigarh.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.

sections.heading: Ayushmann Khurrana — Career and Professional Work
paras: Ayushmann Khurrana works primarily as a film actor, singer, video jockey, television presenter and television actor.
Among the credits most often linked to Ayushmann are Vicky Donor, Dum Laga Ke Haisha, Andhadhun, Shubh Mangal Saavdhan, Bewakoofian, Badhaai Ho, Bareilly Ki Barfi, Article 15, Dream Girl and Bala.
